lead.question: 课文中的'幸运发现'究竟指什么，弗兰克为何能捡到这个大便宜？
lead.warmup: 很多人喜欢逛古玩店，希望能在杂乱的旧货堆里捡到宝贝。但真正的发现从不靠运气，而要有耐心、眼力和行家的知识。本课讲述弗兰克·哈利戴在一家不起眼的古玩店里，凭着一双慧眼，从一只刚运到、无人愿意打开的货箱中，发现了一件被严重低估的珍品，并以极低的价格买下，最终证实是无价之宝。
goals: 掌握 antique、bargain hunter、dealer、rarity、masterpiece 等本课核心词汇。
学会用 exert a fascination on、muster up courage、be about to ... when 等短语描述发现的过程。
理解并运用非限制性定语从句（much of which 结构）以及与过去事实相反的虚拟语气。
体会'发现珍品靠的是知识与耐心，而非运气'这一主题，并能复述故事。
lead.summary: 古玩店对许多人有着特殊的魅力：高档店令人望而却步，不起眼的小店却藏着一线希望。但真正的发现绝非偶然，寻宝者必须有耐心、有眼力，像行家一样辨别价值。弗兰克·哈利戴正是这样的人，他在货箱底部发现一幅微型画，被古董商以50美元卖出，最终证实是柯勒乔的杰作，价值数十万英镑。
lead.tips: 注意 be about to ... when 表示'正要……这时突然……'，when 不能换成 while；exert ... on 中介词固定用 on，不要误用 to。

questions.zh: 那件'幸运的发现'是什么？
questions.a: Frank Halliday discovered a miniature painting at the bottom of a packing case in an antique shop; it proved to be an unknown masterpiece by Correggio, worth hundreds of thousands of pounds.
questions.aZh: 弗兰克·哈利戴在古玩店的一只货箱底部发现了一幅微型画，后来证实是柯勒乔的一幅未被发现的杰作，价值数十万英镑。
questions.hint: 答案见课文末句 'The tiny painting proved to be an unknown masterpiece by Correggio...'。

questions.q: What qualities must a truly dedicated bargain hunter have?
questions.zh: 一个真正执着的寻宝者必须具备哪些品质？
questions.a: He must have patience and, above all, the ability to recognize the worth of something when he sees it; he must be at least as knowledgeable as the dealer.
questions.aZh: 他必须有耐心，而且最重要的是看到珍品时要有识别其价值的能力；他至少要像古董商一样懂行。
questions.hint: 见课文 'A truly dedicated bargain hunter must have patience, and above all, the ability to recognize the worth of something...'。

questions.q: What did Frank notice when he was about to leave the shop?
questions.zh: 弗兰克正准备离开时注意到了什么？
questions.a: He noticed a large packing case lying on the floor.
questions.aZh: 他注意到地板上放着一只很大的货箱。
questions.hint: 见课文 'Frank was about to leave when he noticed a large packing case lying on the floor.'。

questions.q: What did Frank find at the bottom of the packing case, and what did the dealer say it was worth?
questions.zh: 弗兰克在货箱底部发现了什么？古董商说它值多少钱？
questions.a: He found a miniature painting; the dealer glanced at it briefly and said it was worth $50.
questions.aZh: 他发现了一幅微型画；古董商漫不经心地看了一眼，说它值50美元。
questions.hint: 见课文 'suddenly noticed a miniature painting at the bottom of the packing case' 与 'the dealer told him that it was worth $50'。

questions.q: Why does the writer say that no one discovers a rarity by chance?
questions.zh: 作者为什么说没有人是偶然发现珍品的？
questions.a: Because finding a real treasure takes patience and knowledge rather than luck; Frank recognized the painting's composition and line because they reminded him of an Italian painting he knew well, so his discovery came from his eye, not from chance.
questions.aZh: 因为发现真正的珍品靠的是耐心和知识，而不是运气；弗兰克之所以认出那幅画，是因为它的构图和线条让他想起一幅熟悉的意大利画，可见他的发现源于眼力而非偶然。
questions.hint: 结合课文 'No one discovers a rarity by chance.' 与弗兰克认出画作那一段共同思考。

exercises.q: 古玩店对许多人来说有一种特殊的魅力。
exercises.a: Antique shops exert a peculiar fascination on a great many people.

exercises.q: 一个真正执着的寻宝者必须有耐心，而且要有识别珍品价值的能力。
exercises.a: A truly dedicated bargain hunter must have patience, and above all, the ability to recognize the worth of something when he sees it.
exercises.note: bargain hunter 指淘便宜货的人

exercises.q: To do this, he must be at least as knowledgeable as the ______ (古董商).
只有懂行的行家才能分辨出哪件古董是真品，而那幅小画让弗兰克发了一笔大财。
exercises.a: Only a knowledgeable expert can tell which antique is genuine, and the tiny painting made Frank a fortune.
exercises.note: genuine 真品的；make a fortune 发财

exercises.q: The box was full of crockery. Much of it was broken. (用定语从句合并为一句)
exercises.a: The box was full of crockery, much of which was broken.
exercises.note: 非限制性定语从句用 much of which

exercises.q: He was very knowledgeable, so he recognized the painting. (改为与过去事实相反的虚拟语气)
exercises.a: If he had not been so knowledgeable, he would not have recognized the painting.
exercises.note: 与过去相反：had done / would have done

exercises.q: Frank was about to leave while he noticed a large packing case lying on the floor. (改错并改正)
exercises.a: Frank was about to leave when he noticed a large packing case lying on the floor.
exercises.note: be about to ... when，不用 while

quiz.q: 课文中弗兰克'幸运的发现'是什么？
options: A beautifully carved dagger.
An unknown masterpiece by Correggio.
A rare piece of old crockery.
An old Italian glass case.

quiz.q: 'a truly dedicated bargain hunter' 最接近的意思是？
options: A dealer who sells rare antiques.
A scientist bent on a discovery.
A person who patiently hunts for good buys.
A collector who always pays full price.
quiz.note: bargain hunter 淘便宜货的人

quiz.q: 课文中高档古玩店被称为 'a forbidding place'，原因是？
options: It is always crowded with tourists.
It is dirty and full of junk.
It refuses to open its packing cases.
Rare objects are kept in glass cases and it looks intimidating.

quiz.q: 'muster up courage to enter' 中 muster up 的意思是？
options: To gather or summon (courage).
To lose one's courage.
To pay a high price.
To clean up a messy shop.
quiz.note: muster up courage 鼓起勇气

quiz.q: 关于那幅微型画，古董商当时的态度是？
options: He refused to sell it at any price.
He recognized it at once as a masterpiece.
He glanced at it briefly and said it was worth $50.
He wrapped it in glass to keep off dust.

quiz.q: 课文最后，那幅画的真实价值是多少？
options: A mere $50.
Nothing — it turned out to be a copy.
Fifty pounds in cash.
Hundreds of thousands of pounds.
quiz.note: 结局出人意料，价值连城
